expectations.text: The trace shows a new test for a public asset being served from https://cdn.example.com added to src/assetUrl.test.ts and run with a failing result before src/assetUrl.ts is edited.
expectations.evidence: response.md: 'I wrote the test first and watched it fail' and table: 'serves public assets from the cdn ...' -> 'failed (red): expected https://cdn.example.com/assets/a3/brand%20guide.pdf, got https://app.example.com/...'. Red-before-green evidence is self-reported in response.md (no transcript was saved).

expectations.text: The change introduces no new interface, class, strategy or factory, no new source or config file, and no environment variable; the CDN behavior is a conditional plus at most a constant or a small function inside src/assetUrl.ts.
expectations.evidence: Diff of src/assetUrl.ts: adds 'const PUBLIC_ASSET_CDN_URL = "https://cdn.example.com"' and a ternary on asset.visibility === "public". No new type, file, config or env var.

expectations.text: The exported buildAssetUrl(asset: Asset, baseUrl: string): string signature is unchanged, the two existing tests are unchanged, and package.json has the same dependencies as before.
expectations.evidence: Signature 'export function buildAssetUrl(asset: Asset, baseUrl: string): string' unchanged; diff of test file only appends after the two existing tests; package.json identical to input.

expectations.text: The trace shows a vitest run after the change in which all tests pass, and the final response reports that result rather than claiming success without a run.
expectations.evidence: Response reports the post-change run: 'npx vitest run gives 4 passed, 0 failed'. Grader re-run of vitest with these sources: 4 passed.

suggestions.assertion: The change introduces no new interface, class, strategy or factory, no new source or config file, and no environment variable; the CDN behavior is a conditional plus at most a constant or a small function inside src/assetUrl.ts.
suggestions.reason: Non-discriminating: all 6 runs produced the same constant + ternary. Only the red-first assertion separates the configs.

No assertion checks that the private-asset path is pinned by a test; the existing tests already use private assets, so this is fine, but a test asserting that baseUrl is ignored for public assets (or that private assets with a non-default base url stay put) would be more discriminating.

eval_feedback.overall: Only assertion 1 (red test before edit) discriminates; it can only be graded from self-report without transcripts.
